scientific_integrity: The infinite statement is proved using rank and incomparable-atom definability; finite programs independently check examples but do not establish the general result or historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Relative identification among finite divisor lattices in pure reflexive divisibility, with unbounded quantifier depth; not identification among all finite posets. No numerical prime-label recovery, bounded-rank optimization, or independent audit.
title: Two-variable reconstruction of finite divisor lattices
